'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw DS Hunt Down''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

2010 Players Committee sheet, deck name Bonne Nuit. Day 3 is a different 60 ([[2014 Worlds Day 3 Greg Shaw DS Hunt Down]]). Line 35 is Rogue Shadow. Ditto marks expanded. (V) follows the sheet checkbox.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
